label: VERIFIED
extraction: customize-opencode skill: configures opencode.json with strict schema validation. Unknown top-level keys rejected with ConfigInvalidError. Schema: snapshot (bool), instructions (array of files), skills (object with paths[] and urls[]), agent (object keyed by agent name with model, mode, description, permission), command (object keyed by command name with description, prompt), mcp (object with local: command[], enabled, env; remote: url, headers), plugin (array of strings or [name, options] tuples). Model always carries provider prefix (anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6). Skills is object not array. Agent is object not array. Plugin is array not object. MCP command is array of strings, type required.
